Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed with a prayer to direct the court concerned to decide the Case No. 2520 of 2014, arising out of case crime no. 867 of 2013, under Sections 406, 420, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Cantt., District Gorakhpur pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur expeditiously within stipulated period.

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is complainant in the said case and same is pending since 2014 but till date the accused opposite party no.2 Swarnima Singh has not appeared before the trial court despite issuance of summon and bailable warrant and the Court concerned is not taking any interest for compliance of its own order to ensure the appearance of the said accused before it.
4.

sentences.text: 5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
6. It reflects from the perusal of the order sheets that the case is pending since the year 2014 but accused / opposite party no.2 is still free and did not appear before the Court concerned.
The order sheets do not reflect as to whether the orders passed by the Court concerned were actually complied with or not.
The trial court is expected to invoke its power to ensure service of process upon the accused person, which is sent under its seal and order in order to procure the presence of the accused.

7. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to invoke the powers given to it under law to ensure the presence of the accused / opposite party no.2 - Swarnima Singh by sending appropriate process to her within two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, if there is no legal impediment.
8.

It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
